scope: Live DSH desktop sidebar presentation across existing sessions; page-only reload, not runtime recycle

results.observation: The loaded sidebar returned with the right card visible and browser content rendered.

results.check: A to B to C session switch
results.observation: All three existing sessions retained the same right-card open state and approximately 565px width while showing their own conversation contents.
Closing the right card in A and opening the bottom panel carried both visibility choices into B and C; switching alone did not create a terminal in A or B.
Only the terminal created when the bottom panel was manually opened in C was closed; its panel returned to the empty card chooser.
The plus control alternated the single card menu without duplicating tabs or panels; browser was then opened from that menu.

results.check: browser after second page reload and idle
results.observation: The full browser toolbar and DeepSeek page rendered after the second page-only reload and were still visible after ten idle seconds.
The temporary browser tab in C was removed; the window was returned to the new-task welcome view with the right browser card visible and bottom panel closed.
